searchText: Mic broken. 😢 I have a new one ordered. 💔 I have a backup mic, but it is really terrible and it makes my audio output terrible too, so I refuse to use it on principle. I don't want to give it the satisfaction of being used. You can't configure discord to use your current output device, and the backup input device? Or is it a headset, so it'd be pointless? They were spraying the floors with something that likely will kill you if you inhale it. They do that here... spraying chlorine mist to "clean" public areas. Isn't that a chemical weapon? Where are you ? It is a bluetooth headset where I can get good audio out, or I can get crappy audio out + audio in. I said enjinx instead of enginx for way too long 😦 Same This was a good question. IIRC, there is a 50/50 split for having a internal monologue or not. Both sides are really surprised the other exists. Just like sitting/standing! 🤣 https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rubber_duck_debugging but do you need to speak or do you do it as a way to preemptively debug as a habit? need to speak This one is neat. When you imagine an apple, how detailed is it? "I'm really annoyed with philosophy" - Ansgar it's like teaching something to someone helps you learn it 1 Same https://mynoise.net/ Have fun with the philosophy! can't fit EVM traces and the nature of consciousness in my tiny mind at once. gonna go be a meathead and hit the weights till i figure this out. y'all are now my workout mix ok, i do find the idea that the space/time model is evolutionary compelling https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=k1BneeJTDcU BRB: battery dying.
